name: Trenchstar Depths
introDiscord: The trench descends farther than every previous map claimed possible. Shizuki's old markers repeatedly announce that she has 'finally found the bottom.'
introTwitch: The trench descends farther than every previous map claimed possible. Shizuki's old markers repeatedly announce that she has 'finally found the bottom.'

trenchstar-depths-approach.prompt: Three routes descend beneath Marker #1: 'BOTTOM FOUND!'

left.message:
A Trenchstar Behemoth rises from below.

Apparently there is more below.

right.message:
A Berry rests beside Marker #2:

"Correction.

THAT was not bottom.

THIS is bottom."

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary sits inside a deeper crater.

left.message:
Shizuki's tonic rests beneath:

"BOTTOM FOUND FOR REAL THIS TIME."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and continue doubting the signage.

right.message: A Behemoth emerges from yet another lower level.

forward.message: Star Candies glitter inside deep cometglass.

trenchstar-depths-threshold.prompt: Three enormous descents lead toward Bedrock Constellation. Marker #11 waits nearby.

left.message: A star-chart coffer lies beneath Marker #11.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

"I am no longer using the word bottom.

The trench has won."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the bottle. Personal growth has occurred.

forward.message:
"A Trenchstar Behemoth rises from below the supposed lowest point."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The seabed cracks.

There is, unbelievably, more trench underneath it.

Something enormous rises from the darkness.

Use /yes to enter Bedrock Constellation or /no to stop asking how deep this place goes.
bossPromptTwitch:
The seabed cracks.

There is, unbelievably, more trench underneath it.

Something enormous rises from the darkness.

Use !yes to enter Bedrock Constellation or !no to stop asking how deep this place goes.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat upward.

Up is a comforting concept.

boss.revealText:
A colossal star-lit body rises from beneath the bedrock.

Abyssal Star Behemoth reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Behemoth descends again.

You have reached the bottom.

Probably.

No. We're not writing that down."
